text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Transcend didn't seem to be feeling well,
so I brought her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trai-chan.
Good night.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
The nurse's office is for sleeping, y'know?
I'll ping ya when I wake up~...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Where is this...?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...Ah... I see.
Today was the gadget expo here...
Wait, no, the movie... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I can't really remember...
...Oh right, I need to tell Trainy...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...? Wait, Trainy, where'd you go?
I mean, you were just here a second ago—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Hey you, over there.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Howah!? W-What?
Huh, the sky!? I'm floating!? What!?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Did you drop the one-of-a-kind latest gadget? Or perhaps, was it your Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Accu-san...?
What are you saying... Wait,
Trai-chan, you fell down!?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Now, pick whichever one you like.
I'll fetch it for you.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Like there's any other choice!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: You won't regret it, right?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
No, I won't!
What I choose is—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Trainer-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I tell her I just came by to check on how she was doing...
Transcend looks momentarily relieved upon seeing me, but—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Urggghhh...!!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna sleep one more time
and pick out the latest gadget!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Was she talking about a dream?
Transcend burrowed back under
the covers of the futon.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, seeing her flailing her legs about
so energetically brought a wave of relief.
